_meta.status: documented-behavior fixture; replaces live wire until budget approved
_meta.reference_model: gemini-2.5-flash (chosen so 2K-token probes clear the min; 2.5 Pro min is 4096 and storage $4.50/MTok-hr)
notes: EXPLICIT caching: client creates a cachedContents object with a settable TTL (default 1 h) and pays a $/MTok-hour STORAGE fee - the only provider with a posted residency price.
Cached-token reads discounted ~75% off base input.
Explicit cache is an all-or-nothing object (match_mode=breakpoint); TTL is fixed unless explicitly updated - no free refresh-on-hit.
2.5-series models also have IMPLICIT (automatic) caching; this fixture models the explicit path, which is the contract-relevant one.
unverified: Interaction between implicit and explicit caching on the same prefix is undocumented - probe live in M7.

latency_model._comment: synthetic-but-plausible; only latency RATIOS (hit vs miss) matter for verdicts
